reason: The excavator can prepare the ground for the return plant; this is the only available action.
expectation: I expect it to clear or level a stable site, though the exact preparation is unclear.

effect: The levelled footing completes the site and makes adding industrial power the next goal.
reaction: The broad footing and clearance from entrances make practical sense.
reason: The spare solar modules are the only offered gameplay action and should supply power for the plant.
expectation: I expect the modules to be installed on the prepared site to provide additional power.

effect: The separate solar circuit completes the chapter's power goal while preserving the growing room's supply; propellant production itself remains ahead.
reaction: Keeping the farm's power separate is a sensible detail, though the chapter ended just as the return plant was getting started.

mostWorthwhile.text: Installing the solar modules was most worthwhile: the separate industrial circuit connects the return plan to a concrete power requirement without taking the growing room's supply.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the footing was straightforward and the only available action, so it offered little as a decision, even though the result explained its practical purpose.

surprise.text: The chapter ended after the power supply was installed, before any propellant was made.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt purposeless: the footing supports the equipment and the modules supply its power. Both were the only offered gameplay actions, however.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the local-propellant contingency works and how the samples get home; this chapter set that up but stopped before the production process.
